comparison.objective: Place three door hinges at specified edge offsets; candidate commissions an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Measuring, positioning and attaching hinges versus recessed-tool alignment, collar tuning and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Hinges at 5-inch, 10-inch and centred locations versus two safe dynamic stops with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Geometric fixture layout is meaningfully different from tuning and retaining a damping response. Attachment and tolerance details are absent.
